baro.label: BARO-stage2 (adapted: case-level pseudo-series, change-point given)
baro.how: per faulted case: rows = 12 normal cases (time 0..11) + target case (time 12); columns = <agent>_latency; inject_time=12 explicit (change-point given); dataset=None (dataset!=None is degenerate on 1-row segment — see probe); 'time' column filtered from ranking post-hoc.

rcd.label: RCD (adapted: family-pooled; per-case runs but degenerate — see probes)
rcd.how: per fault family: normal_df = 12 normal rows, anomalous_df = family rows (hallucinate 36 / context_drift 36 / wrong_item_pick 12 / format_violation 12); dataset='recshop', gamma=5, localized=True, bins=5, seeds 0-4; single family ranking assigned to every case of the family; partial F-node-neighbour output padded with remaining agents in canonical order. Per-case path probed, NOT structurally impossible: dataset='recshop' -> empty ranking (drop_constant on 1-row segment); dataset=None -> runs but degenerate (1 anomalous sample chi-square is void; 'time' stays a candidate) — see probes incl. rcd_per_case_full_corrected.

baro_dataset_recshop.note: dataset!=None preprocess drops every column of the 1-row anomalous segment (drop_constant on a single row is all-constant) -> empty intersection -> empty ranking

rcd_per_case_recshop.note: dataset!=None preprocess drop_constant kills the 1-row anomalous segment -> empty ranking

rcd_per_case_none.note: mechanically runs, but the chi-square CI has exactly 1 anomalous sample (statistically void) and 'time' stays as a candidate variable -> degenerate; full 96-case appendix run = rcd_per_case_full_corrected

rcd_per_case_full_corrected.note: per-case RCD mechanically RUNS but is degenerate: the chi-square CI has exactly 1 anomalous sample (statistically void), 'time' stays in as a candidate variable in the dataset=None path, and the output is near-constant and lands at/below the constant-Synthesizer prior (NOT below the 0.25 random floor) — this degeneracy (not 'cannot run') is the load-bearing reason for family pooling.
